QuestInfo.name: [Moon Festival] Ceremonial Meal - Brainy Rice
QuestInfo.0:
The fall moon is especially bright during the #e#bMoon Festival!#k#n
Help #eDaddy Moon Bunny#n teach #benemies near your level#k a lesson and recover the #r#t4034991##k item.
#r(You can complete this quest 5 times per day.)#k

#eRewards
#n- 1st time: 1,000x Standard Meso Drop.
#n- 2nd time: 2,000x Standard Meso Drop
#n- 3rd time: 3,000x Standard Meso Drop
#n- 4th time: 4,000x Standard Meso Drop
#n- 5th time: 5,000x Standard Meso Drop

Enemies Near Your Level
#eEnemies Near Your Level#n are enemies as many as #r20 levels below you, or 20 levels above you#k.
#eStandard Meso Drop
#n is the amount of mesos Enemies Near Your Level will drop when defeated. Any enemy Lv. 200+ will count as near your level for this purpose. Note that Heroic players will only receive a #r5x bonus#k.
